description: Use this when the user wants robots.txt lines that control which AI crawlers may read their website. By default it lets AI search and assistant crawlers in (so the site can appear in AI answers) and keeps AI training crawlers out; either can be switched. Optional paths are kept private from every allowed crawler. It returns the lines to paste into robots.txt and which crawlers each group covers. It fetches nothing and needs no website.

allow_search.description: Let AI search and assistant crawlers in (default true).

allow_training.description: Let AI training crawlers in (default false).

disallow_paths.description: Paths every allowed crawler should skip, like ["/admin", "/cart"].

name: generate_ai_robots_txt
title: Generate AI robots.txt lines
